citation.authors: Khan Sullivan AM, Isherwood CM, Hassanin H, et al.
citation.title: Diurnal Variation and Impairment of Postprandial Glucose-Insulin Responses and Lipid Rhythms in Simulated Shift Work

reported.what: model-derived 24 h mean plasma glucose in the day-shift (mmol/L, 95% CI), n=9; the day-shift arm has four meals whose energy is individual and not printed
model-derived 24 h mean plasma insulin in the day-shift (uU/mL, 95% CI)
meals given as percentages of energy with energy set per person by an equation; no energy or gram amounts in the main text

location.quote: Meals comprised 50% carbohydrates (including 15% sugars), 35% fat (11% saturated) and 15% protein.

detail: Every meal is given only as percentages of energy, with each person's energy estimated by the Mifflin St Jeor equation; no energy, gram or body-weight figure is printed in the paper (the composition tables are in the supporting information), so the meals cannot be written and the 24 h means, postprandial iAUCs and rhythms cannot be entered.
